title: Realtime webhook setup — Phoenix → Next.js revalidateTag

content.value: Procedure only. All wire facts — the HMAC scheme, full header sets, the dispatcher/handler header mismatch + declared fix direction, the ±300 s window,
tag scheme — live in the contract: contracts-webhook-realtime.
⚠️ As shipped, dispatcher and SDK handler are wire-incompatible (split vs combined signature header) — a real delivery fails
until the dispatcher is reconciled to the handler's contract. See the contract.
Register a webhook subscription pointed at the Next.js route:

blocks.value:
URL:     https://<your-app>/api/barkpark/webhook
Secret:  <shared-secret>
Events:  create, update, publish, unpublish, delete

content.value: Set the same secret in the deploy environment:
(Node crypto for HMAC). If you mount the handler at a different path, update the Studio webhook URL — the handler is path-agnostic, Studio is not.

blocks.value:
SECRET="<shared-secret>"
T=$(date +%s)
BODY='{"event":"publish","type":"post","doc_id":"p1","dataset":"production","sync_tags":["bp:ds:production:doc:p1","bp:ds:production:type:post"],"timestamp":"2026-04-19T18:42:11Z"}'
SIG=$(printf "%s.%s" "$T" "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$SECRET" -hex | awk '{print $2}')
curl -i -X POST https://<your-app>/api/barkpark/webhook \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-barkpark-delivery-id: smoke-1" \
  -H "x-barkpark-signature: t=${T},v1=${SIG}" \
  -d "$BODY"

content.value: ; replaying the same delivery id returns
for that dataset serves fresh data. First post after a deploy may take 1–2 s on serverless cold starts — the dispatcher retries with backoff and an idempotent delivery id, so no event is lost.
